title: Anyone recognize this?
content: I've been lurking around in this sub for a while and think I've just had one of my first encounters with the phenomenon. The image below is an AI-generated recreation of what I saw and while it's not 100% accurate, it's pretty close. I was in a floatie that I couldn't get out of, slowly heading for a pitch black tunnel under a bridge like some kind of twisted amusement park ride. Has anyone been here or somewhere similar? https://preview.redd.it/bxjp3x8rg3se1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=7e8b1977e1f28b7b9a9e07d3fbc69bf1a2df0698
